newsitem.title: UK: Receivers appointed at Rowco International.
newsitem.headline: Receivers appointed at Rowco International.

text.p: Receivers have been appointed at Aberdeen-based freight forwarder Rowco International Plc, the company said.
Rowco, which specialises in serving the offshore energy industry, said Nick Dargan and Roger Powdrill from Deloitte & Touche have been appointed receivers.
Dargan said: "It is unfortunate that a contractual dispute has resulted in insurmountable cash-flow difficulties."
Rowco said it has an annual turnover of 23 million pounds sterling and employs 90 staff in a number of offices across the UK.

Dargan added:" I am hopeful that, with such a high quality and experienced workforce and a past history of profitable trading, we will be successful in securing a buyer for the business." -- Reuters Shipping News +44 171 542 4087 Fax 5017
